interest.idempotency: one entry per date and account

rules: Use latest known balance per account; older snapshots are history only.
Never sum multiple dates for the same account.
Do not double-count balances repeated in summary and detail sections.
Monies/reward units excluded from CASA, investments and INR net worth.
Fixed deposits separate from CASA and counted once.
Keep Slice, BOI, HDFC, Atom and Roarbank as separate CASA accounts.
Interest is income and increases account balance exactly once; don't add again when newer snapshot includes it.
Investments read from saved holdings; preserve units and cost basis; use latest available price; mark missing price unavailable.
Store bank identity, masked account identifier and current balance in one canonical account record only.
Transactions reference the canonical account; do not repeat bank/account details in transaction rows.
Do not duplicate current bank account details or balances in snapshots or summary payloads.
Update the existing canonical account balance on refresh; retain snapshots only when they add meaningful historical value.

sections.note: Not INR cash; exclude from net worth unless redeemed and credited to bank.
sections.label: Rewards / Monies
